answer: A relationship summary explains the fees and costs associated with a firm’s services. A transaction-based fee typically means paying a commission or markup each time you buy or sell an investment. An asset-based fee is typically an ongoing fee based on your account’s total value. Other fees or costs may also apply, and the fee arrangement depends on your agreement with the broker or adviser.
